title: Senior Data Engineer (Node.js / TypeScript)
description:
Job Title: Senior Data Engineer (Node.js / TypeScript)

Location: Remote – Brazil


Job Description

We are seeking a Senior Data Engineer with strong Node.js and TypeScript expertise to build scalable backend systems and data services. The ideal candidate will have recent hands-on experience with Node.js , strong database expertise in MongoDB and SQL , and experience building high-performance APIs .


This role focuses on designing and developing scalable backend services that support high-volume data processing and integration across digital platforms. Experience with GraphQL is preferred but not mandatory.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services using Node.js and TypeScript .
  • Build and optimize REST/GraphQL APIs for high-performance data access and integration.
  • Develop and maintain data models and database schemas across MongoDB and SQL databases .
  • Implement scalable data ingestion and processing pipelines .
  • Work with distributed systems in a cloud-based environment .
  • Ensure performance optimization, reliability, and scalability of backend services.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including product, architecture, and engineering.
  • Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies such as sprint planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives.
  • Follow DevOps best practices , including CI/CD, testing, and monitoring.


Required Skills

  • 5+ years of experience in backend engineering or data engineering .
  • Strong recent hands-on experience with Node.js .
  • Proficiency in TypeScript and JavaScript .
  • Strong experience with MongoDB and SQL databases .
  • Experience building REST APIs or GraphQL APIs .

title: Senior Data Engineer (Node.js / TypeScript)
description:
Job Title: Senior Data Engineer (Node.js / TypeScript)

Location: Remote – Brazil


Job Description

We are seeking a Senior Data Engineer with strong Node.js and TypeScript expertise to build scalable backend systems and data services. The ideal candidate will have recent hands-on experience with Node.js , strong database expertise in MongoDB and SQL , and experience building high-performance APIs .


This role focuses on designing and developing scalable backend services that support high-volume data processing and integration across digital platforms. Experience with GraphQL is preferred but not mandatory.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services using Node.js and TypeScript .
  • Build and optimize REST/GraphQL APIs for high-performance data access and integration.
  • Develop and maintain data models and database schemas across MongoDB and SQL databases .
  • Implement scalable data ingestion and processing pipelines .
  • Work with distributed systems in a cloud-based environment .
  • Ensure performance optimization, reliability, and scalability of backend services.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including product, architecture, and engineering.
  • Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies such as sprint planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives.
  • Follow DevOps best practices , including CI/CD, testing, and monitoring.


Required Skills

  • 5+ years of experience in backend engineering or data engineering .
  • Strong recent hands-on experience with Node.js .
  • Proficiency in TypeScript and JavaScript .
  • Strong experience with MongoDB and SQL databases .
  • Experience building REST APIs or GraphQL APIs .
  • Solid understanding of data modeling and database design .
  • Experience working in cloud environments (AWS preferred) .
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, testing frameworks, and modern development practices .


Nice to Have

  • Experience with GraphQL architecture or schema design .
  • Experience with distributed systems and high transaction platforms .
  • Knowledge of ETL pipelines and data processing frameworks .
  • Experience working in digital media, sports, or high-scale consumer platforms .


Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field , or equivalent practical experience.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
About the Role

We’re building an AI-driven product and looking for a Full Stack Engineer to join our growing team. You’ll work closely with the founder, product manager, and designer in a hands-on role that suits someone who thrives in fast-moving environments and wants to make a real impact in a small, ambitious team.


Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain end-to-end web applications using React, Node.js, and PostgreSQL.
  • Collaborate with product and design to deliver high-quality, scalable features.
  • Own the full development lifecycle, from architecture to deployment.
  • Write clean, maintainable code and help define best practices.
  • Evaluate technical tradeoffs and propose efficient solutions.
  • Communicate clearly and proactively in a distributed team.

  • Solid understanding of design principles, Git, and CI/CD.
  • Excellent communication skills in English (C1).
  • Proactive, self-driven, and comfortable working independently.
  • located in Brazil


Nice to Have

  • Experience with AI-related products or APIs.
  • Knowledge of TypeScript or other modern frameworks.
  • Interest in product thinking and user experience.

description:

Profissional de nível Pleno/Sênior que atue com (Dados/IA).

Responsabilidades:

  • Atuar como referência técnica na construção de soluções agentic unindo engenharia de dados em Azure e Copilot Studio;

  • Domínio de Python e SQL para transformação e automação;
  • Conhecimento prático de RAG, embeddings, vetorização e estratégias de recuperação de informação;
  • Experiência com integrações via REST APIs e conectores corporativos;

Diferencial:

  • Experiência com Microsoft Fabric (Lakehouse, Data Pipelines, Dataflows Gen2, Semantic Model);
  • Vivência com Azure AI Foundry e/ou Azure OpenAI para orquestração e avaliação de modelos;

  • Observabilidade e avaliação de agentes: testes, métricas de qualidade, feedback loop e melhoria contínua;

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas ;

title: Product Owner Pleno (PO)
description:
Olá, somos a SuperFrete :)


Queremos ser a maior e mais amada rede de logística digital, quer fazer parte disso?


Somos uma startup que atua no segmento do varejo e logística, apoiando os pequenos e médios empreendedores a se tornarem mais competitivos no mercado e a alavancarem suas vendas. Por isso, buscamos um(a) Super Product Owner Pleno , que se identifique com o nosso propósito, que tenha muita energia para somar no time de Produtos e que queria crescer (muito!) com a gente.


Responsabilidades:

Estratégia e visão de produto

  • Contribuir para a definição da visão do produto e alinhamento com stakeholders;
  • Identificar problemas relevantes e oportunidades de melhoria baseadas em dados e feedback de usuários;
  • Priorizar iniciativas alinhadas aos OKRs trimestrais.


Discovery e validação de soluções

  • Conduzir discovery contínuo para entendimento profundo de problemas e necessidades;
  • Criar e validar hipóteses de solução antes da implementação em escala;
  • Construir ou apoiar a construção de MVPs rápidos utilizando ferramentas de IA, prototipação e low-code;
  • Testar soluções com usuários antes de direcionar o time de engenharia.


Gestão do produto e delivery

  • Criar épicos e histórias de usuário bem estruturadas, com critérios de aceite claros;
  • Gerir backlog upstream e downstream;
  • Priorizar e refinar demandas com o time de tecnologia;
  • Orientar o time sobre regras de negócio e objetivos das entregas;
  • Avaliar e aceitar entregas garantindo aderência aos critérios definidos.


Colaboração com o time

  • Trabalhar próximo aos times de UX, Engenharia e Dados;
  • Participar de rituais do time (dailys, refinamentos, planning e retrospectivas);
  • Garantir clareza de contexto e objetivos para o time multidisciplinar.


Gestão por dados

  • Monitorar métricas de produto e comportamento do usuário;
  • Utilizar dados para validar hipóteses e apoiar decisões de produto;
  • Conduzir experimentos (A/B tests, testes de solução, validações rápidas).


Requisitos:

  • Experiência sólida atuando como Product Manager ou Product Owner;
  • Forte habilidade de priorização de backlog;
  • Experiência com Discovery e Delivery de produto;
  • Capacidade de estruturar histórias de usuário, critérios de aceite e cenários;
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis como Scrum e Kanban;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de produto (Jira, Miro ou similares);
  • Experiência com análise de dados de produto (Amplitude, Mixpanel, Google Analytics, HubSpot ou similares);
  • Experiência com testes e experimentação em produtos digitais;
  • Experiência com métricas de produto digital.


Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento em estatística ou ciência de dados;
  • Noções de arquitetura e stacks de tecnologia (backend, web, app, infraestrutura);
  • Experiência em varejo, e-commerce ou marketplaces;
  • Experiência em startups;
  • Experiência com prototipação rápida e ferramentas de construção low-code / IA.


O que esperamos dessa pessoa:

  • Forte orientação a resolver problemas reais dos usuários ;
  • Mentalidade data-driven ;
  • Capacidade de tomar decisões com autonomia e responsabilidade ;
  • Perfil mão na massa , confortável em testar soluções rapidamente;
  • Curiosidade e abertura para trabalhar com IA e novas ferramentas de construção de produto ;
  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de colaboração com times multidisciplinares.


O que você pode esperar dos Supers?

  • Uma cultura de muita confiança, colaboração, focada em resultados, com muita autonomia e transparência;
  • Buscamos excelência em tudo o que fazemos, por isso estamos sempre aprendendo;
  • Temos vontade de construir junto, fazer a diferença e gerar impacto.



O que oferecemos:

description:
Cód. 58788


Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

title: Eletricista Subtransmissão Linha Viva II
description:
Sinta a nossa energia!


Somos um time de 16 mil colaboradores próprios, espalhados por 18 estados brasileiros e no Distrito Federal. Aqui, os sotaques se misturam, integração, colaboração e segurança são elementos fundamentais em nosso dia a dia. Atuamos em toda a cadeia do setor elétrico brasileiro, Geração, Transmissão, Distribuição e Comercialização. Juntos, somos essa Neoenergia toda!

Queremos liderar a transição energética no Brasil e ser a escolha número 1 para brasileiros e brasileiras. E faremos isso com pessoas de todos os gêneros, raças, idades, orientações sexuais e com deficiências. Investimos em diversidade, inovação e tecnologias para oferecer a melhor experiência de soluções energéticas conectadas a cada um dos nossos 16 milhões de clientes!




Sua energia será muito importante para:

Responsável por executar as manutenções e operações das linhas de transmissão e subestações do sistema elétrico da Coelba, segundo normas e procedimentos estabelecidos, garantindo a qualidade, confiabilidade, segurança e a continuidade do fornecimento de energia elétrica em todo o estado da Bahia.



Atividades:

  • Trabalhar em conformidade com procedimentos e manual de conduta;
  • Executar tarefas de suporte administrativo/de escritório em um ambiente de escritório, campo ou local;
  • Execução das inspeções visuais, termográficas, manutenções preditivas, preventivas e corretivas nos ativos de subtransmissão;
  • Garantir a qualidade das intervenções por meio da execução de serviços de manuseio, transporte de carga/descarga de equipamentos e materiais de uso na manutenção;
  • Assegurar melhorias de qualidade em subestações e linhas por meio do auxílio na execução de obras CAPEX e OPEX nessas instalações;
  • Reduzir tempo e número de interrupções fortuitas através de serviços de apoio a outras áreas, associados a operação e manutenção em linhas de subtransmissão e distribuição;
  • Acompanhamento diário dos registros de eventos de relés digitais e identificação e correção de falhas em ativos de subtransmissão;
  • Coordenar trabalhos de campo, dirigir viaturas, planejar atividades, interpretar projetos, relatórios e relatórios da ordem de serviço, realizar acompanhamento das obras em campo, orientar sobre risco de acidente, prestar suporte de socorro em caso de acidente, e ou problemas de saúde, realizar integração / DSS com sua equipe;
  • Elaborar planos operacionais, colaborando com sugestões, fazendo mudanças de funções , delegando atividades e supervisionando o trabalho das equipes;
  • Desenvolver a sua equipe de maneira a promover o crescimento profissional e intelectual de cada membro.





Para fazer parte do nosso time, você precisa ter:

  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Formação de Linha Viva em Subtransmissão;
  • Experiência com linha viva 13.8 kv até 138kv;
  • Cursos de NR 10 básico, NR 10 SEP, NR 35 e Redes de Distribuição;
  • Carteira de Habilitação D ;
  • Pacote office - nível básico;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar na cidade de Feira de Santana/ BA .





Para você ficar com a energia lá em cima, confira nossos benefícios:

  • Plano de Saúde e Odonto lógico para cuidar de você e de seus dependentes.
  • Vale Alimentação para fazer aquele mercado reforçado ou Vale Refeição para confraternizar com os colegas no horário de almoço;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resu ltados da empresa, o momento mais esperado do ano!;
  • Licença maternidade estendida , para um puerpério com mais tranquilidade;
  • Licença pate rnidade, para ficar bem perto da sua família nos primeiros dias do bebê;
  • Licença para casais homoafetivos , porque aqui reconhecemos todos os tipos de família;
  • Gympass para você fazer atividade física e ficar cheio de energia;
  • Programa de Idiomas para você poder se aperfeiçoar em outro idioma;
  • Auxílio Creche para te apoiar com o cuidado dos seus filhos;
  • Previdência Privada para você ter um futuro mais tranquilo;
  • Seguro de Vida para apoiar nossos colaboradores em todos os momentos.




Quer saber mais sobre a Neoenergia? Acompanhe as nossas redes sociais!

title: Freight Desk Manager
description:
Position Scope

The Freight Desk Manager is a high-impact leadership role responsible for architecting and overseeing the logistics support function for non-finished goods on a global scale, with a dedicated focus on the LATAM region . This position operates at the intersection of global procurement and operational execution, managing a complex ecosystem of freight forwarders, control towers, and internal stakeholders. The mission is to ensure world-class shipment execution and financial integrity through robust audit structures and the expansion of logistics capabilities in high-growth markets.

Responsibilities and Accountabilities

  • Regional Strategy & Expansion: Serve as the primary architect for logistics operations in LATAM, including the enablement of Importer of Record (IOR) operations and regional supplier onboarding.
  • Global Freight Desk Leadership: Lead the logistics support function for specialized shipments, managing a network of global freight forwarders operating through dedicated control towers.
  • Rate Card Governance: Standardize and maintain global Bulk Air and Ocean rate cards across a diverse portfolio of international suppliers to ensure cost consistency and transparency.
  • Strategic Sourcing: Lead RFQs and supplier onboarding initiatives for logistics, ensuring all partners meet global compliance and service level standards.
  • Governance & Audit Architecture: Design and maintain a global freight audit strategy and control architecture to ensure financial discipline across high-volume global invoice environments.
  • Control Tower Oversight: Drive operational excellence by governing forwarder performance, ensuring industry-leading on-time shipment execution across all transport modes.
  • Automation & Process Engineering: Implement automated invoice approval systems and systemic controls to improve first-pass yield and overall operational efficiency.
  • Stakeholder Management: Partner with global cross-functional teams to support non-standard logistics requirements and rapid-response delivery programs.

Mandatory Requirements

  • Experience: Extensive experience in Global Supply Management, Logistics Procurement, or Supply Chain Operations within multinational environments.
  • Regional Expertise: Deep knowledge of the LATAM logistics landscape , including regulatory requirements, customs, and supplier networks.
  • Procurement Mastery: Proven track record in leading RFQs and managing complex logistics supplier onboarding processes.

title: Freight Desk Manager
description:
Position Scope

The Freight Desk Manager is a high-impact leadership role responsible for architecting and overseeing the logistics support function for non-finished goods on a global scale, with a dedicated focus on the LATAM region . This position operates at the intersection of global procurement and operational execution, managing a complex ecosystem of freight forwarders, control towers, and internal stakeholders. The mission is to ensure world-class shipment execution and financial integrity through robust audit structures and the expansion of logistics capabilities in high-growth markets.

Responsibilities and Accountabilities

  • Regional Strategy & Expansion: Serve as the primary architect for logistics operations in LATAM, including the enablement of Importer of Record (IOR) operations and regional supplier onboarding.
  • Global Freight Desk Leadership: Lead the logistics support function for specialized shipments, managing a network of global freight forwarders operating through dedicated control towers.
  • Rate Card Governance: Standardize and maintain global Bulk Air and Ocean rate cards across a diverse portfolio of international suppliers to ensure cost consistency and transparency.
  • Strategic Sourcing: Lead RFQs and supplier onboarding initiatives for logistics, ensuring all partners meet global compliance and service level standards.
  • Governance & Audit Architecture: Design and maintain a global freight audit strategy and control architecture to ensure financial discipline across high-volume global invoice environments.
  • Control Tower Oversight: Drive operational excellence by governing forwarder performance, ensuring industry-leading on-time shipment execution across all transport modes.
  • Automation & Process Engineering: Implement automated invoice approval systems and systemic controls to improve first-pass yield and overall operational efficiency.
  • Stakeholder Management: Partner with global cross-functional teams to support non-standard logistics requirements and rapid-response delivery programs.

Mandatory Requirements

  • Experience: Extensive experience in Global Supply Management, Logistics Procurement, or Supply Chain Operations within multinational environments.
  • Regional Expertise: Deep knowledge of the LATAM logistics landscape , including regulatory requirements, customs, and supplier networks.

description:

title: Analytics Engineer - Sênior
description:
No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.


Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.


E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?

  • Garante o self-service e acesso à informação através de modelagens de tabelas e métricas coesas, escaláveis e de alto impacto, construindo pipelines robustos e resilientes;

  • Experiência em ferramentas de visualização de dados (Power BI e Looker Studio preferencialmente), com capacidade de estruturar dashboards estratégicos e narrativas de dados de alto impacto;
  • Noções em ferramentas de orquestração de pipelines (Ex. Airflow ou equivalentes);
  • Sólida vivência em versionamento de código (Git), com prática de code review, padrões de branches e integração contínua;


Diferencial

  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de modelagens para IA em iniciativas de ML, copilots, agentes e observabilidade.

title: Technical Recruiter
description:
About IDP

At International Digital Partners (IDP) , we connect top global talent with fast-growing, innovative companies. We are a fully remote, multicultural team focused on delivering real value to our clients through technology, consulting, and digital execution. Our mission is to build world-class technical teams, and that’s where you come in.


About the Role

We are looking for a Technical Recruiter , highly experienced, self-driven, and multilingual, to join our international Talent Acquisition team. This is a key role in helping us scale technical teams across the U.S., Latin America, and Europe. You'll own full-cycle recruitment for high-demand technical roles.


Key Responsibilities

  • Manage the full recruitment life cycle for technical roles: intake, sourcing, interviewing, coordinating, and offer negotiation;
  • Screen and assess candidates, both on soft skills and basic technical fit;
  • Source talent proactively via LinkedIn Recruiter, referrals, and other sourcing platforms;
  • Maintain clear, professional communication in English and Spanish.
  • Build and nurture a pipeline of high-quality candidates across multiple regions and time zones;
  • Ensure a seamless, positive candidate experience from first contact to onboarding;
  • Contribute to process improvement and employer branding initiatives.


Requirements

Must-Haves:

  • 3+ years of experience in technical recruiting, with proven success in international or remote hiring;
  • Solid understanding of tech stacks, tools, and roles (e.g., Frontend, Backend, Full Stack, DevOps, Data, QA);
  • Fluency (B2) in English is a must; Fluency in Spanish is highly preferred but not required
  • Experience using ATS platforms (e.g., Manatal, Greenhouse, Bullhorn) and sourcing tools like LinkedIn Recruiter;
  • Ability to operate independently in a remote, fast-paced, multicultural environment;
  • Strong organizational and interpersonal skills, with a solution-oriented mindset.


Nice-to-Haves:

  • Background in tech consulting or staffing;
  • Experience hiring across LATAM, U.S., and Europe;
  • Knowledge of international hiring models (contracting, nearshoring, etc.);
  • Familiarity with Agile environments and distributed tech teams.


What We Offer

  • Fully remote, international working environment
  • Supportive, multicultural team and collaborative culture
  • Access to innovative global projects with high impact
  • Continuous learning and growth opportunities

title: Electrical BIM Lead
description:
Eracore is an electrical engineering and BIM company delivering complex Electrical BIM models for large construction projects across the U.S. Our team brings together top talent to work on some of the most interesting and technically demanding electrical projects, including data centers, government facilities, industrial buildings, and advanced commercial projects.


We are proud of the work we do, and we invite you to take a look:


Eracore is growing in Brazil , and we are excited to welcome new team members. We are building a permanent and professional team to work on Electrical BIM projects for the U.S. market. If you enjoy teamwork, learning, and doing quality work, you will feel at home with us.


Why You’ll Enjoy Working at Eracore

  • Competitive hourly pay
  • Fully remote work
  • Learning platforms for professional growth
  • Supportive leadership and mentorship


Your Role

  • Lead and support the development of Electrical BIM models
  • Review models, perform clash detection, and ensure quality standards
  • Support and mentor BIM team members
  • Coordinate with other BIM trades
  • Prepare BIM documents such as reports, schedules, execution plans and shop drawings
  • Work daily with Revit and Navisworks and Bluebeam
  • Improve workflows and modeling processes when needed
  • Communicate clearly with client BIM teams throughout the project


What We’re Looking For

  • 4+ years of experience in Electrical BIM
  • Strong understanding of electrical systems
  • Advanced Revit skills with an electrical focus
  • Experience using Navisworks for coordination and clash detection
  • Familiarity with BIM 360, ACC, and Bluebeam
  • Team-oriented mindset with experience in managing the team
  • 2+ successfully finished projects
  • Reliable, organized, and deadline-focused

title: ITSM Support Specialist
description:
We are looking for an Ivanti ITSM Specialist to take over the managed support and administration of an existing Ivanti environment. The main goal is to ensure platform stability, manage day-to-day operations, and support the ITSM application while parallel assessments are running.

Key Responsibilities

  • Platform Administration: Handle day-to-day configuration and maintenance of the Ivanti ITSM platform.
  • Queue Management: Manage incident and request queues, performing triage and ensuring timely resolution.
  • User Management: Administer users, groups, and maintain the service catalog.
  • Reporting: Generate and maintain dashboards and operational reports as needed.
  • Maintenance & Support: Provide minor enhancements and break-fix support to ensure \"nothing stops, nothing breaks.\"
  • Vendor Liaison: Act as the point of contact with Ivanti vendors for technical escalations.

Technical Requirements (Must-haves)

  • Experience: Proven experience administering Ivanti Service Management (ISM) or Ivanti Neurons for ITSM .
  • ITSM Knowledge: Strong understanding of IT Service Management processes (Incident, Request, Change management).
  • Reporting: Ability to run and customize reports within the Ivanti environment.
  • Soft Skills: Proactive \"keep the lights on\" mindset, ability to work independently, and clear communication.

  • Garante o self-service e acesso à informação através de modelagens de tabelas e métricas coesas, escaláveis e de alto impacto, construindo pipelines robustos e resilientes;
  • Atua na detecção, prevenção e solução de problemas complexos relacionados à disciplina de dados, propondo soluções definitivas e escaláveis que eliminem a recorrência de falhas;
  • Participa de iniciativas estratégicas de dados da tribo, desde o planejamento até a entrega, garantindo alinhamento entre equipes técnicas e de negócio, e promovendo excelência na tomada de decisão baseada em dados;
  • Realiza análises críticas do que está sendo desenvolvido, avaliando impacto, qualidade e reuso por outros times, tanto do ponto de vista de dados quanto de negócio;
  • Propõe e implementa melhorias contínuas em processos de dados, orquestrando stakeholders e fomentando boas práticas que elevem o nível de maturidade analítica da organização;
  • Apoia e pareia com analistas de outros níveis, disseminando conhecimento e boas práticas.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Experiência em programação (preferencialmente Python), com aplicação prática em automação, análise avançada e engenharia de dados
  • Domínio em modelagem de dados (conceitual, lógica e física), com experiência comprovada em ambientes complexos e de grande escala;
  • Excelência em SQL, capaz de desenvolver consultas altamente otimizadas e escaláveis;
  • Experiência em ferramentas de visualização de dados (Power BI e Looker Studio preferencialmente), com capacidade de estruturar dashboards estratégicos e narrativas de dados de alto impacto;
  • Noções em ferramentas de orquestração de pipelines (Ex. Airflow ou equivalentes);
  • Sólida vivência em versionamento de código (Git), com prática de code review, padrões de branches e integração contínua;


Diferencial

  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de modelagens para IA em iniciativas de ML, copilots, agentes e observabilidade.

title: Technical Recruiter
description:
About IDP

At International Digital Partners (IDP) , we connect top global talent with fast-growing, innovative companies. We are a fully remote, multicultural team focused on delivering real value to our clients through technology, consulting, and digital execution. Our mission is to build world-class technical teams, and that’s where you come in.


About the Role

We are looking for a Technical Recruiter , highly experienced, self-driven, and multilingual, to join our international Talent Acquisition team. This is a key role in helping us scale technical teams across the U.S., Latin America, and Europe. You'll own full-cycle recruitment for high-demand technical roles.


Key Responsibilities

  • Manage the full recruitment life cycle for technical roles: intake, sourcing, interviewing, coordinating, and offer negotiation;
  • Screen and assess candidates, both on soft skills and basic technical fit;
  • Source talent proactively via LinkedIn Recruiter, referrals, and other sourcing platforms;
  • Maintain clear, professional communication in English and Spanish.
  • Build and nurture a pipeline of high-quality candidates across multiple regions and time zones;
  • Ensure a seamless, positive candidate experience from first contact to onboarding;
  • Contribute to process improvement and employer branding initiatives.


Requirements

Must-Haves:

  • 3+ years of experience in technical recruiting, with proven success in international or remote hiring;
  • Solid understanding of tech stacks, tools, and roles (e.g., Frontend, Backend, Full Stack, DevOps, Data, QA);
  • Fluency (B2) in English is a must; Fluency in Spanish is highly preferred but not required
  • Experience using ATS platforms (e.g., Manatal, Greenhouse, Bullhorn) and sourcing tools like LinkedIn Recruiter;
  • Ability to operate independently in a remote, fast-paced, multicultural environment;
  • Strong organizational and interpersonal skills, with a solution-oriented mindset.


Nice-to-Haves:

  • Background in tech consulting or staffing;
  • Experience hiring across LATAM, U.S., and Europe;
  • Knowledge of international hiring models (contracting, nearshoring, etc.);
  • Familiarity with Agile environments and distributed tech teams.


What We Offer

  • Fully remote, international working environment
  • Supportive, multicultural team and collaborative culture
  • Access to innovative global projects with high impact
  • Continuous learning and growth opportunities

title: Freight Desk Manager
description:
Position Scope

The Freight Desk Manager is a high-impact leadership role responsible for architecting and overseeing the logistics support function for non-finished goods on a global scale, with a dedicated focus on the LATAM region . This position operates at the intersection of global procurement and operational execution, managing a complex ecosystem of freight forwarders, control towers, and internal stakeholders. The mission is to ensure world-class shipment execution and financial integrity through robust audit structures and the expansion of logistics capabilities in high-growth markets.

Responsibilities and Accountabilities

  • Regional Strategy & Expansion: Serve as the primary architect for logistics operations in LATAM, including the enablement of Importer of Record (IOR) operations and regional supplier onboarding.
  • Global Freight Desk Leadership: Lead the logistics support function for specialized shipments, managing a network of global freight forwarders operating through dedicated control towers.
  • Rate Card Governance: Standardize and maintain global Bulk Air and Ocean rate cards across a diverse portfolio of international suppliers to ensure cost consistency and transparency.
  • Strategic Sourcing: Lead RFQs and supplier onboarding initiatives for logistics, ensuring all partners meet global compliance and service level standards.
  • Governance & Audit Architecture: Design and maintain a global freight audit strategy and control architecture to ensure financial discipline across high-volume global invoice environments.
  • Control Tower Oversight: Drive operational excellence by governing forwarder performance, ensuring industry-leading on-time shipment execution across all transport modes.
  • Automation & Process Engineering: Implement automated invoice approval systems and systemic controls to improve first-pass yield and overall operational efficiency.
  • Stakeholder Management: Partner with global cross-functional teams to support non-standard logistics requirements and rapid-response delivery programs.

Mandatory Requirements

  • Experience: Extensive experience in Global Supply Management, Logistics Procurement, or Supply Chain Operations within multinational environments.
  • Regional Expertise: Deep knowledge of the LATAM logistics landscape , including regulatory requirements, customs, and supplier networks.
  • Procurement Mastery: Proven track record in leading RFQs and managing complex logistics supplier onboarding processes.
  • Network Management: Experience managing large-scale global freight forwarder relationships and \"Control Tower\" operational models.
  • Technical Proficiency: Strong background in Logistics Financial Control (Freight Audit) and managing high-volume, global-scale invoice environments.
  • Leadership: Experience leading international teams and managing external providers across different time zones (APAC, EMEA, AMR).
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, International Trade, or a related field.
  • Languages: Fluency in English is essential for regional and global coordination.

Desirable Requirements

  • Advanced Education: MBA or Master’s degree.
  • Process Excellence: Certifications in Lean Six Sigma or similar experience.
  • Digital Transformation: Experience implementing AI-driven or automated financial auditing and rate management tools.
  • Rapid Growth Background: Experience managing logistics for hyper-growth programs (e.g., international express expansions or specialized delivery models).

O Butantan é o maior produtor de vacinas e soros da América Latina e o principal fabricante de imunizantes contra a gripe (influenza) do hemisfério Sul. title: Freight Desk Manager
description:
Position Scope

The Freight Desk Manager is a high-impact leadership role responsible for architecting and overseeing the logistics support function for non-finished goods on a global scale, with a dedicated focus on the LATAM region . This position operates at the intersection of global procurement and operational execution, managing a complex ecosystem of freight forwarders, control towers, and internal stakeholders. The mission is to ensure world-class shipment execution and financial integrity through robust audit structures and the expansion of logistics capabilities in high-growth markets.

Responsibilities and Accountabilities

  • Regional Strategy & Expansion: Serve as the primary architect for logistics operations in LATAM, including the enablement of Importer of Record (IOR) operations and regional supplier onboarding.
  • Global Freight Desk Leadership: Lead the logistics support function for specialized shipments, managing a network of global freight forwarders operating through dedicated control towers.
  • Rate Card Governance: Standardize and maintain global Bulk Air and Ocean rate cards across a diverse portfolio of international suppliers to ensure cost consistency and transparency.
  • Strategic Sourcing: Lead RFQs and supplier onboarding initiatives for logistics, ensuring all partners meet global compliance and service level standards.
  • Governance & Audit Architecture: Design and maintain a global freight audit strategy and control architecture to ensure financial discipline across high-volume global invoice environments.
  • Control Tower Oversight: Drive operational excellence by governing forwarder performance, ensuring industry-leading on-time shipment execution across all transport modes.
  • Automation & Process Engineering: Implement automated invoice approval systems and systemic controls to improve first-pass yield and overall operational efficiency.
  • Stakeholder Management: Partner with global cross-functional teams to support non-standard logistics requirements and rapid-response delivery programs.

Mandatory Requirements

  • Experience: Extensive experience in Global Supply Management, Logistics Procurement, or Supply Chain Operations within multinational environments.
  • Regional Expertise: Deep knowledge of the LATAM logistics landscape , including regulatory requirements, customs, and supplier networks.
  • Procurement Mastery: Proven track record in leading RFQs and managing complex logistics supplier onboarding processes.
  • Network Management: Experience managing large-scale global freight forwarder relationships and \"Control Tower\" operational models.
  • Technical Proficiency: Strong background in Logistics Financial Control (Freight Audit) and managing high-volume, global-scale invoice environments.
  • Leadership: Experience leading international teams and managing external providers across different time zones (APAC, EMEA, AMR).
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, International Trade, or a related field.
  • Languages: Fluency in English is essential for regional and global coordination.

Desirable Requirements

  • Advanced Education: MBA or Master’s degree.
  • Process Excellence: Certifications in Lean Six Sigma or similar experience.
  • Digital Transformation: Experience implementing AI-driven or automated financial auditing and rate management tools.
  • Rapid Growth Background: Experience managing logistics for hyper-growth programs (e.g., international express expansions or specialized delivery models).

title: Senior Golang Engineer
description:
Please note that the project operates in the UK time zone.


We are seeking a dedicated, motivated, and reliable Senior Golang Engineer who is interested in providing innovative software solutions for our clients. Be a part of our team as we continue to deliver high quality products and services. The Senior Go Engineer will be responsible for building backend services in Go in EKS, as well as some Lambdas. The overall project will be centered around providing product data and managing the product life cycle. If you are an open communicator with a passion for learning, love to think outside the box and you are excited about software development, we are looking for you!


RESPONSIBILITIES

• Use your deep expertise in Go and related technologies to develop high-quality, scalable, maintainable software solutions.

• Make technically sound decisions and champion high standards of coding and architecture best practices.

• Develop and maintain software documentation such as technical specifications and design documents.

• Continually enhance the team’s performance by mentoring, code reviews, and improving current processes in the SDLC.

• Troubleshoot and debug software issues as they arise.

• Collaborate within a cross functional team and be able to transform both functional and non-functional requirements into actionable work.

• Manage communication of progress/status to stakeholders.


WE ARE LOOKING FOR

• At least 4 years of professional software development experience.

• Proficiency in Go (Golang), including syntax, semantics, database connectivity, and object-oriented concepts.

• Strong understanding of data structures and algorithms.

• Experience working with Go frameworks such as Gin, Revel, Echo, Beego, etc.

• Strong understanding of web services (HTTP, SOAP, REST, GQL, etc.).

• Terraform, Lambdas, Writing API’s.

• Strong working knowledge of relational databases.

• Experience in troubleshooting issues and root cause analysis.

• A proven track record of delivering high quality and tested software on-time and often.

• An open mind, and the patience to explain issues in a constructive manner.

• Strong communication skills, with at least an intermediate level of English.

• Experience working in distributed, cross functional teams.


NICE TO HAVE

• Kubernetes or EKS.

• Algolia.

• Shopify.

• DynamoDB


Who We Are?

We are a fast growing business and technology consultant company co-founded in 2019. We offer a custom-tailored, white-glove engineering service fit for our clients, because a digital transformation is more than just technology. With a successful track record of being a preferred vendor for Fortune 500 companies and as a trusted partner for some of the industry’s leading companies, our global talent has helped many clients achieve their goals.


What's In It For You

  • We offer 100% remote work
  • Wellness/Fitness package
  • Paid trainings and certifications
  • 22 days of paid leave (27 days in the second year with us)
  • Professional Conferences and Training
  • Global Team Building Activities
  • Access to co-working spaces worldwide


Your applications and referrals are welcome!

title: Principal Project Manager Fast response Team
description:
T-Systems, a German multinational company belonging to the Deutsche Telekom Group, is looking for a highly experienced Principal Project Manager to join our Fast Response Team , supporting critical projects and services that require rapid stabilization and recovery.


This team plays a key role in safeguarding complex global projects, ensuring they return to the right track while rebuilding customer confidence.



Key responsibilities


• Plan and manage projects in a highly complex global IT environment

• Lead large interdisciplinary teams and subcontractors during project recovery and stabilization phases

• Implement quality gates, define corrective measures and monitor execution

• Conduct project reviews, identify weaknesses and drive improvement actions

• Define project structure, procedures and quality assurance measures

• Plan, schedule and control project phases, timelines and cost plans

• Manage project resources, including external partners, ensuring delivery on time, quality and budget

• Lead project status meetings and steering committees, reporting to senior leadership and top management

• Handle escalations, de-escalations and conflict management

• Apply best practices as part of the Zero Failure Program

• Establish cross-production control mechanisms to ensure implementation of quality measures

• Contribute to the evolution of project management and ITIL standards



Your profile


• At least 8+ years of experience in project or program management within IT environments

• Proven experience managing complex global IT projects with multiple international stakeholders

• Strong background in Data Center environments, cloud technologies and modern IT processes (AI, cloud, etc.)

• Solid experience in quality management, reporting and governance frameworks

• Deep understanding of IT service environments including application operations, infrastructure, networks and desktop services

• Strong knowledge of ITIL processes and service management practices

• Experience working in multicultural and international environments

• Outstanding skills in communication, negotiation, problem solving and decision-making

• Strong presentation and facilitation skills

• Highly proactive, structured and results-oriented mindset


Languages


• German – Business fluent

• English – Business fluent



If you are passionate about leading complex IT programs, solving critical project situations and working in an international environment, we would love to hear from you!

Overall Responsibilities: The Transportation Specialist will be responsible for supporting our e-Commerce Transportation Operation for North America. The specialist will work with carriers, customers and internal stakeholders to execute daily transportation management functions following documented SOPs and providing status updates to the hiring manager.


Core Responsibilities


1. Data Analysis & Shipment Integrity (Primary Focus)

• Proactive Monitoring: Query large datasets to identify lagging or \"at-risk\" shipments across sales, returns, and trade-in flows.

• Performance Reporting: Maintain and update centralized KPI boards and dashboards to ensure real-time visibility for internal stakeholders.

• SQL Management: Execute minor SQL queries to extract, filter, and audit transportation data from internal databases.

• Root Cause Analysis: Perform deep-dive investigations into weekly and monthly On-Time Delivery (OTD) fluctuations to identify systemic carrier or lane issues.


2. Transportation Operations Support (Secondary Focus)

• Escalation Management: Resolve complex shipment status inquiries by collaborating with carriers (UPS, FedEx, DHL), 3PL partners, and Fulfillment teams.

• Master Data Maintenance: Support the Transportation Operations Manager in configuring and troubleshooting master data within the Transportation Management System (TMS).

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as the data subject matter expert (SME) for ongoing logistics projects and process improvement initiatives.


Technical Requirements

• Data Handling: 1–3 years of professional experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or a data-intensive operations role.

• SQL Proficiency: Ability to write and execute basic SQL queries for data extraction and manipulation.

• Advanced Tooling: Expert-level proficiency in Google Sheets and Microsoft Excel (Pivot Tables, complex formulas, data cleaning).

• Visualization: Experience maintaining or updating dashboards (e.g., Tableau, Looker, or Data Studio).


Operational Requirements

• Industry Knowledge: Foundational understanding of parcel transportation or warehouse operations.

• Analytical Thinking: Proven ability to navigate ambiguity, identify trends in \"noisy\" data, and propose actionable solutions.

• Communication: Strong ability to present data findings in a clear, concise manner to both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Outstanding follow-through, time management and planning skills to deliver results.

• Able to work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment as the market develops in unpredictable ways, producing high quality work and projecting a positive attitude.


Preferred Skills/Qualifications:

• Experience operating within a Transportation Management System (TMS).

• Prior experience working with major parcel carriers, such as DHL Express, UPS, and FedEx.

• Intermediate to Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (or Google Workspace), with working knowledge of SQL and Tableau.

• Prior Forecasting experience


Location: LATAM (Must align with US PST Time Zone)


Language Requirement:

Advanced English

title: Analista de Tesouraria Jr (Crédito e Cobrança)
description:
Você está em uma jornada para ingressar em uma empresa emocionante e fazer parte de nossa história de sucesso. Aqui vamos equipá-lo com o know-how e a experiência que definirão seu crescimento. Nesta função em que você está prestes a embarcar, você deve cumprir as seguintes responsabilidades:


  • Avaliar, com suporte e orientação, crédito para novos clientes, através do levantamento e análise de documentações, referências comerciais e informações financeiras dos clientes (ex. balanço patrimonial, DRE e fluxo de caixa), visando assegurar uma avaliação consistente e evitar inadimplência.
  • Realizar a classificação de risco de crédito (rating), validar com seu superior imediato, recomendar limites de crédito e encaminhar para análise da seguradora.
  • Analisar limites de crédito definido pela seguradora e inserir a validação de liberação de crédito no cadastro dos clientes.
  • Emitir Relatório de Rating dos clientes.
  • Realizar o processo para revisão de limite de crédito para os clientes e validar junto ao seu superior imediato.
  • Acompanhar e analisar status de ordens bloqueadas para faturamento, a fim de identificar e avaliar as informações que estejam impactando na liberação, bem como atuar nas ações necessárias para desbloqueio.
  • Realizar o processo de cobrança junto a clientes inadimplentes, negociando a regularização dos títulos em aberto.


Requisitos:

  • Superior Completo em Administração, Economia, Ciências Contábeis ou áreas correlatas;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas e sistemas de análise de crédito (ex.: relatórios Serasa, balanço financeiro) que permite avaliar e analisar riscos de crédito;
  • Conhecimento das técnicas de cobrança, técnicas de negociação e em matemática financeira (ex.: cálculos de juros/encargos, projeções de crédito e caixa);
  • Vivência em Pacote Office, principalmente Excel;
  • Disponibilidade para atuação 100% presencial em Feira de Santana-BA, para vaga temporária(licença maternidade);
  • Diferencial: experiência com o sistema SAP.


Aviso Legal:

Ao nos enviar seu currículo e dados pessoais, considera-se que você deu seu consentimento para que mantenhamos suas informações em nosso banco de dados de recrutamento de talentos. Todas as informações fornecidas serão usadas exclusivamente para o processo seletivo. A RGE somente coletará, utilizará, processará ou divulgará informações pessoais quando e onde for permitido pelas leis aplicáveis.


Somente os candidatos pré-selecionados serão contatados para entrevista. Nos empenhamos em responder a todos os candidatos. No entanto, se você não receber uma resposta nossa em até 60 dias, por favor, considere sua candidatura para esta vaga como não aprovada. Podemos entrar em contato futuramente para oportunidades que correspondam às suas qualificações e experiência.


Obrigado por considerar uma carreira na RGE.

description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.


Somos globais, somos GPTW.


♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!


Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!


Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:


Cientista de Dados Especialista em IA


Descrição da posição


Profissional atuará no desenvolvimento de soluções baseadas em LLMs (Large Language Models), com foco na criação de prompts avançados e agentes de IA, apoiando a evolução de soluções analíticas aplicadas a produtos e plataformas digitais.


A atuação envolve o desenvolvimento de Prompt Engineering, integração com dados estruturados e não estruturados e construção de agentes inteligentes, garantindo qualidade, governança e confiabilidade das respostas geradas pelos modelos.


Responsabilidades


Desenvolver, testar e refinar prompts utilizando técnicas avançadas de Prompt Engineering, como Chain-of-Thought, Few-shot e ReAct

Criar e evoluir agentes de IA baseados em LLMs

Avaliar a performance de diferentes modelos e agentes para casos de uso específicos

Preparar e estruturar dados estruturados e não estruturados para alimentar modelos de linguagem

Garantir que prompts e agentes sigam diretrizes de segurança, governança e ética, evitando alucinações e outputs inconsistentes

Atuar em conjunto com diferentes áreas para integrar soluções de IA generativa em produtos e sistemas

Apoiar na construção de mecanismos de monitoramento e avaliação de outputs gerados por agentes de IA


Requisitos obrigatórios


Formação em Estatística, Matemática, Engenharia, Ciência da Computação, Física ou áreas correlatas

Experiência prática no desenvolvimento de prompts e agentes de IA utilizando sistemas baseados em LLMs

Domínio de Python

Experiência em manipulação e análise de dados utilizando SQL

Experiência com modelagem preditiva e machine learning

Conhecimento do mercado de crédito ou produtos financeiros


  • Idioma: Inglês é considerado um diferencial, mas não obrigatório


E temos o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!

title: Salesforce Developer
description:
At Avenue Code, we are passionate about transforming businesses through technology. We are a leading end-to-end development consultancy for digital transformation across various markets, growing sustainably since day one. We believe that great results are born from strong relationships. Our team combines technical expertise, collaboration, and a welcoming approach to work that makes all the difference.


About The Opportunity


We are looking for a Salesforce Developer to join a team responsible for evolving and optimizing a Salesforce Service Cloud environment. In this role, you will collaborate with Salesforce engineers, administrators, and business stakeholders to design, develop, and deploy solutions that improve operational processes and platform adoption. You will work with both declarative configurations and custom development to support Customer Experience initiatives and scalable Salesforce capabilities.


Responsibilities


  • Design and implement solutions using Salesforce Service Cloud, leveraging both declarative features and custom development.
  • Develop custom functionality using Apex, Lightning Components, and Lightning Web Components.
  • Configure, enhance, and maintain standard and custom Salesforce capabilities to support the CX team, including custom objects, workflows, Process Builder, Lightning Flows, sharing rules, email alerts, quick actions, and Embedded Service chat deployments.
  • Support integrations, platform enhancements, and new feature development.
  • Manage code deployments across multiple environments.
  • Build and maintain reports and dashboards to support business insights.
  • Contribute to the documentation of Salesforce configurations and integrations.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable solutions for customer experience operations.


Required Qualifications


  • Strong experience working with Salesforce development and configuration.
  • Proficiency with Apex, JavaScript, SOQL, SOSL, Lightning Components, and Lightning Web Components.
  • Experience working with Salesforce automation tools, reporting, and dashboards.
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Ability to work effectively in collaborative environments with tight timelines.
  • Background in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related fields.


Nice To Have Skills


  • Experience supporting customer experience (CX) or service operations teams.
  • Familiarity with community portals or help center implementations.
  • Salesforce certifications.


Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: Veterinary Radiologist
description:
Veterinary Radiologist - Remote


About SignalPET


SignalPET is a pioneering technology company reshaping veterinary medicine through AI-powered radiograph interpretation. Our mission is to provide fast, accurate, and accessible diagnostic insights to veterinarians around the world.


Role Overview


We are seeking experienced Veterinary Radiologists based in Brazil to join us. In this 100% remote role, you will review AI-assisted radiographic studies, validate findings, and support clinical quality initiatives. This is a unique chance to combine your clinical expertise with innovative technology on a global scale.


Key Responsibilities


  • Review and interpret routine small-animal radiographic studies.
  • Validate the accuracy of AI-generated reports.
  • Provide expert insights and feedback on reported cases.
  • Collaborate with veterinarians and fellow radiologists worldwide.
  • Participate in quality control and system enhancement projects.
  • Stay informed on developments in diagnostic imaging and veterinary AI.


Qualifications


  • Médico Veterinário with specialization in Diagnóstico por Imagem or Radiologia Veterinária .
  • M.V., MSc or M.V., PhD preferred.
  • 5+ years of experience in small animal diagnostic imaging.
  • Strong diagnostic and communication skills.
  • Proficient in English (written and spoken).
  • Self-motivated, reliable, and detail-oriented.
  • Comfortable working independently and remotely.


What We Offer


  • Fully remote role (Brazil-based).
  • Supportive, international team and culture.
  • Full training provided—no prior AI experience required.
  • A meaningful opportunity to shape the future of veterinary diagnostics.



*** IMPORTANT NOTICE ***


This role has had to be re-advertised due to candidates not responding to LinkedIn messages sent to arrange interviews.


Please ensure that you check your LinkedIn messages daily and respond promptly. Failure to respond may result in your application not being considered further.


We appreciate your cooperation and look forward to hearing from responsive candidates.

title: Senior Business Analyst – Supply Chain
description:
Who We Are

We are an IFS integrator, providing end-to-end ERP implementation projects and exceptional support services. As strategic business partners, we collaborate with clients across key industries, helping them drive digital transformation.

Our global team of 200+ members brings extensive expertise, including former IFS customers who understand real-world operational challenges and dedicated IFS specialists with deep functional and technical knowledge. Together, we deliver outstanding services to reshape businesses and optimize supply chain operations.


Who We Are Looking For

We are currently seeking a Senior Business Analyst – Supply Chain , a client-facing leadership role responsible for driving complex ERP implementations within supply chain domains (procurement, inventory, logistics, planning, and distribution).

This role requires a strong functional expert who can lead requirement gathering, solution design, and implementation while acting as a key advisor to clients and an escalation point for junior analysts.

If you are passionate about supply chain optimization, ERP transformation, and leading cross-functional collaboration in global projects, we encourage you to apply.


Key Responsibilities

Business Requirements & Client Engagement

• Lead requirement gathering sessions with stakeholders across supply chain functions.

• Analyze business processes (procurement, inventory, warehousing, logistics) to identify improvements and optimization opportunities.

• Translate complex supply chain and technical concepts into clear language for non-technical stakeholders.

• Perform gap analysis between current operations and ERP capabilities, ensuring scalable and efficient solutions.

• Advise clients on best practices aligned with industry standards and digital transformation strategies.


Solution Design, Implementation & Testing

• Lead supply chain module implementation within ERP (IFS or similar).

• Supervise and mentor Business Analysts and Junior Analysts within the domain.

• Collaborate with Project Managers on planning, estimations, and risk mitigation.

• Work closely with development and technical teams to ensure accurate solution delivery.

title: QA/QC Manager – Data Centers
description:
The Client


Datacenter People is working with the largest building commissioning and operational risk management providers in the world.


What the Job Involves…

  • Actively supports the Company’s commitment to safety and its core values.
  • Performs quality inspections in accordance with program quality control documentation. Participate and guide project quality control from kick-off until hand-off.
  • Provides oversight of the implementation of the QA/QC management system at site.
  • Coordinates the quality inspections with the site sub-contractors and vendors.
  • Coordinates with the customers representative on all quality matters.
  • Provides oversight in the distribution of relevant QA/QC documentation to site subcontractors while reviewing that completed documentation is stored appropriately upon completion.
  • Verifies that the quality related site activities are in accordance with the design documents and program standards.
  • Participates in the internal and external site audits.
  • Coordinates all the quality site inspections through the Contractor QC team.
  • Ensures all quality control documentation is compiled and competed for as-built hand over through the Contractor QC team.
  • Provide review and reporting of all non-conformance reports and undertake remedial action. Monitors the implementation of the approved site QC Plan.
  • Completes and coordinates the approval of the sites QC technical submittals to the customer.
  • Coordinates with the Client and Contractor QA/QC team on all quality issues.
  • Coordinate and chair the QA/QC site weekly meetings with the Contractor QC personnel.
  • Assures all technical documents relative to site quality control are of current status.


We’re Looking for Someone Who…

  • Data center commissioning/QA experience.
  • Has a Bachelor's degree in an engineering discipline preferred.
  • Has Certifications in Lean, Six Sigma, Quality Auditor, and/or Quality Engineer a plus.
  • Is experienced with ISO 9001 certification process.
  • Has a history and experience driving improved Quality at scale.
  • Is able to work seamlessly across functional and department lines.
  • Has experience with standard data center equipment to include: electrical distribution equipment from switchgear to panelboards, VFDs, low voltage power and moulded case circuit breakers, overhead IT busway, Diesel Generators, DX units, air handlers, water treatment equipment, BMS modules, and hot aisle containment accessories.
  • Is able to travel domestically and internationally as needed.


We regret that due to the high volume of applications we are unable to acknowledge each one. Please bear in mind that if you are selected for interview we will contact you within the next seven days.

title: QA/QC Manager – Data Centers
description:
The Client


Datacenter People is working with the largest building commissioning and operational risk management providers in the world.


What the Job Involves…

  • Actively supports the Company’s commitment to safety and its core values.
  • Performs quality inspections in accordance with program quality control documentation. Participate and guide project quality control from kick-off until hand-off.

  • Assures all technical documents relative to site quality control are of current status.


We’re Looking for Someone Who…

  • Data center commissioning/QA experience.
  • Has a Bachelor's degree in an engineering discipline preferred.
  • Has Certifications in Lean, Six Sigma, Quality Auditor, and/or Quality Engineer a plus.
  • Is experienced with ISO 9001 certification process.
  • Has a history and experience driving improved Quality at scale.
  • Is able to work seamlessly across functional and department lines.
  • Has experience with standard data center equipment to include: electrical distribution equipment from switchgear to panelboards, VFDs, low voltage power and moulded case circuit breakers, overhead IT busway, Diesel Generators, DX units, air handlers, water treatment equipment, BMS modules, and hot aisle containment accessories.
  • Is able to travel domestically and internationally as needed.

title: DevOps Sr
description:
O Inatel está recrutando Especialista para atuar como DevOps, no ICC SOFT.

Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Realizar a atualização de sistemas (deployment) utilizando tecnologia específica do projeto;
  • Desenvolver scripts de alta complexidade para automatização de deployment do projeto ou qualquer outra tarefa que o projeto julgue necessária sua automatização;
  • Realizar monitoramento de sistemas e aplicações utilizando tecnologia definida no projeto, analisar de a alta complexidade em dados obtidos, e realizar configurações complexas na ferramenta;
  • Definir arquitetura em termos de documentação e tecnologia;
  • Utilizar plataformas de computação em nuvem e provisionar recursos e serviços básicos de cloud, de forma manual e automatizada;
  • Desenvolver ferramentas web de complexidade média para uso interno do projeto;
  • Documentar processos e soluções técnicas de acordo com as necessidades do projeto;
  • Analisar e resolver incidentes críticos de software e infraestrutura no sistema;
  • Realizar automatização de processo de Build;
  • Analisar e isolar o defeito apontado no processo de testes da solução, bem como identificar a causa raiz e propor uma solução a fim de atender aos processos de qualidade de software;
  • Criar documentações complementares de acordo com as necessidades do projeto;
  • Aplicar novos procedimentos de desenvolvimento de software, conforme necessidade, descrevendo métodos e operacionalização dos mesmos, em sequência padronizada, de acordo com o sistema de qualidade assegurada, a fim de buscar melhorias contínuas;
  • Atuar como agente multiplicador de conhecimentos, prestando suporte técnico ao time.


Requisitos e qualificações

Ensino superior completo, preferencialmente em cursos de Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou Ciência da Computação;


Forte compreensão de arquiteturas nativas de nuvem (cloud-native), incluindo Kubernetes, microsserviços e malha de serviços (service mesh);


Domínio em:

  • Ferramentas para deployment (ex: Jenkings, Ansible, Puppet, Chef, Travis CI, Salt),
  • Plataformas de computação em nuvem (ex: AWS, Openstack, Google Cloud),
  • Criação de scripts em Shell Script, Python ou PHP,
  • Automatização de cloud (ex: Terraform, Cloud Formation),
  • Infraestrutura como Código,
  • Linguagem de programação para automatização de testes (ex: Selenium, Javascript, Phanton JS, Casper JS),
  • Ferramentas de controle de versão (Ex.:GIT, Gerrit),
  • Lógica de Programação;


Conhecimentos em:

  • Ferramentas Grafana, Graphite, ELK,
  • Utilização de container Docker, Kubernetes, Gerenciamento de ambiente Linux,
  • Banco de Dados (Ex: SQL Server, MySQL, Cassandra) SQL/NoSQL, consulta e criação de tabelas/esquemas/scripts,
  • Métodos de desenvolvimento de sistemas (Ex: Scrum) e ferramenta de controle (EX: Jira);


Noções sobre Segurança e Vulnerabilidade (Ex. SQL injection, cross-site scripting, CSRF, SSL, etc);


Inglês avançado / fluente para conversação devido contato diário com equipes internacionais.

Informações adicionais

Horário de trabalho : Segunda à sexta-feira, das 8h as 12h e das 13h00 as 17h00.


Local de trabalho : As atividades serão realizadas em regime de Teletrabalho \"Home Office\".

title: Salesforce Developer
description:
At Avenue Code, we are passionate about transforming businesses through technology. We are a leading end-to-end development consultancy for digital transformation across various markets, growing sustainably since day one. We believe that great results are born from strong relationships. Our team combines technical expertise, collaboration, and a welcoming approach to work that makes all the difference.


About The Opportunity


We are looking for a Salesforce Developer to join a team responsible for evolving and optimizing a Salesforce Service Cloud environment. In this role, you will collaborate with Salesforce engineers, administrators, and business stakeholders to design, develop, and deploy solutions that improve operational processes and platform adoption. You will work with both declarative configurations and custom development to support Customer Experience initiatives and scalable Salesforce capabilities.


Responsibilities


  • Design and implement solutions using Salesforce Service Cloud, leveraging both declarative features and custom development.
  • Develop custom functionality using Apex, Lightning Components, and Lightning Web Components.
  • Configure, enhance, and maintain standard and custom Salesforce capabilities to support the CX team, including custom objects, workflows, Process Builder, Lightning Flows, sharing rules, email alerts, quick actions, and Embedded Service chat deployments.
  • Support integrations, platform enhancements, and new feature development.
  • Manage code deployments across multiple environments.
  • Build and maintain reports and dashboards to support business insights.
  • Contribute to the documentation of Salesforce configurations and integrations.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable solutions for customer experience operations.


Required Qualifications


  • Strong experience working with Salesforce development and configuration.
  • Proficiency with Apex, JavaScript, SOQL, SOSL, Lightning Components, and Lightning Web Components.
  • Experience working with Salesforce automation tools, reporting, and dashboards.
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Ability to work effectively in collaborative environments with tight timelines.
  • Background in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related fields.


Nice To Have Skills


  • Experience supporting customer experience (CX) or service operations teams.
  • Familiarity with community portals or help center implementations.
  • Salesforce certifications.


Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: Veterinary Radiologist
description:
Veterinary Radiologist - Remote


About SignalPET


SignalPET is a pioneering technology company reshaping veterinary medicine through AI-powered radiograph interpretation. Our mission is to provide fast, accurate, and accessible diagnostic insights to veterinarians around the world.


Role Overview


We are seeking experienced Veterinary Radiologists based in Brazil to join us. In this 100% remote role, you will review AI-assisted radiographic studies, validate findings, and support clinical quality initiatives. This is a unique chance to combine your clinical expertise with innovative technology on a global scale.


Key Responsibilities


  • Review and interpret routine small-animal radiographic studies.
  • Validate the accuracy of AI-generated reports.
  • Provide expert insights and feedback on reported cases.
  • Collaborate with veterinarians and fellow radiologists worldwide.
  • Participate in quality control and system enhancement projects.
  • Stay informed on developments in diagnostic imaging and veterinary AI.


Qualifications


  • Médico Veterinário with specialization in Diagnóstico por Imagem or Radiologia Veterinária .
  • M.V., MSc or M.V., PhD preferred.
  • 5+ years of experience in small animal diagnostic imaging.
  • Strong diagnostic and communication skills.
  • Proficient in English (written and spoken).
  • Self-motivated, reliable, and detail-oriented.
  • Comfortable working independently and remotely.


What We Offer


  • Fully remote role (Brazil-based).
  • Supportive, international team and culture.
  • Full training provided—no prior AI experience required.
  • A meaningful opportunity to shape the future of veterinary diagnostics.



*** IMPORTANT NOTICE ***


This role has had to be re-advertised due to candidates not responding to LinkedIn messages sent to arrange interviews.


Please ensure that you check your LinkedIn messages daily and respond promptly. Failure to respond may result in your application not being considered further.


We appreciate your cooperation and look forward to hearing from responsive candidates.

title: DevOps Sr
description:
O Inatel está recrutando Especialista para atuar como DevOps, no ICC SOFT.

Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Realizar a atualização de sistemas (deployment) utilizando tecnologia específica do projeto;
  • Desenvolver scripts de alta complexidade para automatização de deployment do projeto ou qualquer outra tarefa que o projeto julgue necessária sua automatização;
  • Realizar monitoramento de sistemas e aplicações utilizando tecnologia definida no projeto, analisar de a alta complexidade em dados obtidos, e realizar configurações complexas na ferramenta;
  • Definir arquitetura em termos de documentação e tecnologia;
  • Utilizar plataformas de computação em nuvem e provisionar recursos e serviços básicos de cloud, de forma manual e automatizada;
  • Desenvolver ferramentas web de complexidade média para uso interno do projeto;
  • Documentar processos e soluções técnicas de acordo com as necessidades do projeto;
  • Analisar e resolver incidentes críticos de software e infraestrutura no sistema;
  • Realizar automatização de processo de Build;
  • Analisar e isolar o defeito apontado no processo de testes da solução, bem como identificar a causa raiz e propor uma solução a fim de atender aos processos de qualidade de software;
  • Criar documentações complementares de acordo com as necessidades do projeto;
  • Aplicar novos procedimentos de desenvolvimento de software, conforme necessidade, descrevendo métodos e operacionalização dos mesmos, em sequência padronizada, de acordo com o sistema de qualidade assegurada, a fim de buscar melhorias contínuas;
  • Atuar como agente multiplicador de conhecimentos, prestando suporte técnico ao time.


Requisitos e qualificações

Ensino superior completo, preferencialmente em cursos de Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou Ciência da Computação;


Forte compreensão de arquiteturas nativas de nuvem (cloud-native), incluindo Kubernetes, microsserviços e malha de serviços (service mesh);


Domínio em:

  • Ferramentas para deployment (ex: Jenkings, Ansible, Puppet, Chef, Travis CI, Salt),
  • Plataformas de computação em nuvem (ex: AWS, Openstack, Google Cloud),
  • Criação de scripts em Shell Script, Python ou PHP,
  • Automatização de cloud (ex: Terraform, Cloud Formation),
  • Infraestrutura como Código,
  • Linguagem de programação para automatização de testes (ex: Selenium, Javascript, Phanton JS, Casper JS),
  • Ferramentas de controle de versão (Ex.:GIT, Gerrit),
  • Lógica de Programação;


Conhecimentos em:

  • Ferramentas Grafana, Graphite, ELK,
  • Utilização de container Docker, Kubernetes, Gerenciamento de ambiente Linux,
  • Banco de Dados (Ex: SQL Server, MySQL, Cassandra) SQL/NoSQL, consulta e criação de tabelas/esquemas/scripts,
  • Métodos de desenvolvimento de sistemas (Ex: Scrum) e ferramenta de controle (EX: Jira);


Noções sobre Segurança e Vulnerabilidade (Ex. SQL injection, cross-site scripting, CSRF, SSL, etc);


Inglês avançado / fluente para conversação devido contato diário com equipes internacionais.

Informações adicionais

Horário de trabalho : Segunda à sexta-feira, das 8h as 12h e das 13h00 as 17h00.


Local de trabalho : As atividades serão realizadas em regime de Teletrabalho \"Home Office\".

title: Cientista de Dados Especialista em IA
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.


Somos globais, somos GPTW.


♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!


Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!


Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:


Cientista de Dados Especialista em IA


Descrição da posição


Profissional atuará no desenvolvimento de soluções baseadas em LLMs (Large Language Models), com foco na criação de prompts avançados e agentes de IA, apoiando a evolução de soluções analíticas aplicadas a produtos e plataformas digitais.


A atuação envolve o desenvolvimento de Prompt Engineering, integração com dados estruturados e não estruturados e construção de agentes inteligentes, garantindo qualidade, governança e confiabilidade das respostas geradas pelos modelos.


Responsabilidades


Desenvolver, testar e refinar prompts utilizando técnicas avançadas de Prompt Engineering, como Chain-of-Thought, Few-shot e ReAct

Criar e evoluir agentes de IA baseados em LLMs

Avaliar a performance de diferentes modelos e agentes para casos de uso específicos

Preparar e estruturar dados estruturados e não estruturados para alimentar modelos de linguagem

Garantir que prompts e agentes sigam diretrizes de segurança, governança e ética, evitando alucinações e outputs inconsistentes

Atuar em conjunto com diferentes áreas para integrar soluções de IA generativa em produtos e sistemas

Apoiar na construção de mecanismos de monitoramento e avaliação de outputs gerados por agentes de IA


Requisitos obrigatórios


Formação em Estatística, Matemática, Engenharia, Ciência da Computação, Física ou áreas correlatas

Experiência prática no desenvolvimento de prompts e agentes de IA utilizando sistemas baseados em LLMs

Domínio de Python

Experiência em manipulação e análise de dados utilizando SQL

Experiência com modelagem preditiva e machine learning

Conhecimento do mercado de crédito ou produtos financeiros


  • Idioma: Inglês é considerado um diferencial, mas não obrigatório


E temos o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!
